undersized_feedback.condition: Smallest grade, formed, enabled, valid front, RU; public doEnergyInjection, not direct old doInject bypass.

overload_policy.old: First protection increments count and clears buffer without setting stopped.

overload_policy.condition: Original protection counter initially0; legal formed/enabled front; no external interception.
overload_policy.policy: Do not automatically restore old damage or eliminate modern safeguards.

old_capacity_overshoot_excluded.policy: Keep bounded floor acceptance; do not restore source over-capacity rounding and resulting overload.

port_emission_query.condition: Valid formed rear energy-output part, EU, no attached cover.
port_emission_query.limit: An interface metadata mismatch; does not prove sideways transfer or energy duplication.

readability.limit: Formatting and eight local/lambda bindings only; no public signatures or gameplay changed.

Original Base10 environmental checks return true, not the energy-converter weather checks; no new017 host claimed.

provenance: Original Dynamo: GregTech-6 Team2025, Gregorius Techneticies, LGPL-3.0-or-later. Referenced sources retain separate notices. Only existing port source formatting/local names changed; no original/native bodies or assets newly copied to production.
limitations: No Java compilation or target initialization, Gradle, tests, game/client sound, energy execution, saves restart, build or push.
Source sets and finite arithmetic are not six assembled machines, TPS measurements or external mod compatibility acceptance.
Only stated source consumers are audited. Recipes, client models, whole saved-world lifecycle and other energy/controllers remain in the full queue.

root_revalidation.kind: Source hash and full selected token/literal checks, native entry identity, bounded source witnesses and added documentation only.
